items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag
items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benötigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: This is a private cooperative housing letter, not from an authority, so no statutory Bekanntgabefiktion applies; the period runs from the letter's own date as the letter defines it. Start: Briefdatum = Wed 18.11.2026; under §187 Abs.1 BGB the event day itself is not counted, so counting begins the next day, Thu 19.11.2026 = day 1. The letter defines Werktage as Montag bis Samstag, with Sonn- und Feiertage not counted, so Sundays are skipped and only nationwide/NW holidays would be skipped (none fall in this window). Counting Werktage: 19.11(1) Thu,20.11(2) Fri,21.11(3) Sat,[22.11 Sun skipped],23.11(4) Mon,24.11(5) Tue,25.11(6) Wed,26.11(7) Thu,27.11(8) Fri,28.11(9) Sat,[29.11 Sun skipped],30.11(10) Mon,01.12(11) Tue,02.12(12) Wed,03.12(13) Thu,04.12(14) Fri. Day 14 = Fri 04.12.2026, which is not itself a Sunday/holiday, so no further shift is needed.
